local: 10 warps share row sums. Each thread packs 16 rounded values.
Keeping y on chip saves 20 KiB per token: 10 KiB written and 10 KiB read.
output: The MLP reads this input. The residual has its own BF16 write.

reload: 读回 y，每 16 个元素为一组
local: 10 个 warp 共享平方和，每个线程打包 16 个舍入后的值。
y 留在片上，每个 token 省去 10 KiB 写入和 10 KiB 读取，共 20 KiB。
output: 打包数据并按 GEMM 布局排列 scale
供 MLP 读取；更新后的残差另以 BF16 写回。

load: Normalize and rotate Q and K
reload: Read K, then pack K and V
local: Four warps reduce one head. The key CTA packs K and V for the cache.
Keeping rotated K on chip saves 1 KiB per token per KV head: 512 B each way.
output: Q goes to attention. Gate is saved for the epilogue.

load: Q、K 分别归一化，再做旋转编码
store: 每个 KV head 有 256 个值
reload: 读回 K，打包 K 和 V
local: 4 个 warp 协作归约一个 head。负责 K 的 CTA 接着打包 K 和 V。
旋转后的 K 留在片上，每个 token、每个 KV head 省去一写一读，各 512 B，共 1 KiB。
output: Q 送入 attention，gate 保留给后续门控。

load: Paged KV for attention, split scratch for merge
reload: Read O and apply the gate
local: Read gate and scale, then pack eight E4M3 values into one 8-byte store.
Keeping final O on chip saves 6 KiB per token on this rank: 3 KiB each way.

load: 单任务直接输出，多任务由最后的 CTA 合并
分页 KV 或分片合并暂存区
store: 写回完整的注意力输出
reload: 各 head 的最终输出
local: 在最终写出线程内门控
读取 gate 与 scale，将 8 个 E4M3 值打包，一次写出 8 字节。
最终 O 留在片上，每个 token 在这张卡上省去 3 KiB 写入和 3 KiB 读取，共 6 KiB。
output: 打包输出投影所需的激活

pipe.tip.en:
{0} · GPU{1} · C{2}Stage {3} · {4}
Prior context: {5}C
Start: {6} u
End: {7} u
Duration: {8} u
pipe.tip.zh-CN:
{0} · GPU{1} · C{2}Stage {3} · {4}
历史：{5}C
开始：{6} u
结束：{7} u
耗时：{8} u

pipe.startNote.en: C0 starts on GPU0. CPP runs 16 layers per stage and VPP runs eight. Both paths process all 64 layers.
pipe.startNote.zh-CN: 第一份 Chunk 从 GPU0 出发。CPP 一次执行 16 层，VPP 一次执行 8 层；两条路线最终都完成 64 层计算。

pipe.fillNote.en: Each GPU starts as soon as its input arrives. GPU0 keeps admitting chunks. The VPP warmup counts are 7 / 5 / 3 / 1, so inner ranks begin the return leg first.
pipe.fillNote.zh-CN: 各卡收到输入便开始计算，GPU0 同时继续处理新的 Chunk。VPP 的暖机预算由外向内为 7 / 5 / 3 / 1，让折返工作逐级接入。

pipe.turnNote.en: C0 reaches GPU3 and moves locally from S3 to S4. Older chunks start the return leg while newer ones move forward. Both legs share the compute stream on each rank.
pipe.turnNote.zh-CN: C0 到达 GPU3，在本地从 S3 进入 S4。更早的 Chunk 开始折返，较新的 Chunk 继续前进；两段工作开始共用各 Rank 的 Compute Stream。

pipe.steadyNote.en: Each GPU alternates between an older chunk on the return leg and a newer chunk on the forward leg. Eight-layer stages let work on the second half of the network start earlier.
pipe.steadyNote.zh-CN: 同一张 GPU 交错执行较早 Chunk 的 Return 与较新 Chunk 的 Forward。计算粒度减半，后半段的层被提前穿插到前向流水中。

pipe.drainNote.en: All chunks have entered the pipeline. VPP finishes the remaining return stages. CPP still has to move the last, most expensive chunks through its physical stages.
pipe.drainNote.zh-CN: 所有 Chunk 已进入流水。VPP 先前已经推进了部分后半程工作，现在依次完成剩余的 Return；CPP 继续沿物理 Stage 完成最后的长 Chunk。

pipe.uniformNote.en: With equal chunk costs, both schedules finish together. Select increasing costs to see how a growing KV history changes pipeline fill and drain.
pipe.uniformNote.zh-CN: 等耗时模型下，两条路线的总完成时间相同。切换到“逐步增长”，观察历史 KV 带来的成本变化怎样影响填排过程。

pipe.growthNote.en: In this model CPP finishes at {0} u and VPP at {1} u. The amount of compute is the same. Stage size and local execution order determine the difference.
pipe.growthNote.zh-CN: 当前模型中，CPP 完成于 {0} u，VPP 完成于 {1} u。总计算工作相同，差别来自 Stage 粒度与本地执行顺序。

rank.progress.en: Advance DMA and exchange READY / ACK
rank.progress.zh-CN: 推进 DMA / 交换 READY–ACK

rank.capacity.en: Fixed buffers at C8192: 2 source + 3 receive slots = 800 MiB
rank.capacity.zh-CN: 固定数据缓冲：2 × Source + 3 × Receive = 800 MiB

rank.diagram.en: GPU1 shared buffers and three CUDA streams

rank.overviewNote.en: One compute stream runs both legs on each rank. The legs share two physical source slots and three receive slots. Each edge tracks its own sequence numbers and events.
rank.overviewNote.zh-CN: 一个 Rank 以同一条 Compute Stream 执行 Forward 与 Return。发送共用 2 个物理 Slot，接收共用 3 个物理 Slot；各通信边保留自己的序列号和事件。

rank.receiveNote.en: The shared H2D stream writes incoming data from both legs to the receive arena. One slot supplies the running stage. The others prefetch admitted forward or return inputs in FIFO order.
rank.receiveNote.zh-CN: 共享 H2D Stream 将两个方向的数据写进 Receive Arena。当前输入供计算使用，其余空间预取下一份 Forward / Return；预取按已准入的 FIFO 身份建立。

rank.computeNote.en: The compute stream waits for the matching receive event, runs S1 or S6, and records a consumer event after the stage has finished reading its input.
rank.computeNote.zh-CN: Compute 等待对应的接收完成 Event，然后运行 S1 或 S6。Stage 的最后一次输入消费结束时，记录 Consumer Event。

rank.sendNote.en: A stage publishes its output in a source slot. When a captured stage returns separate storage, its output is copied into that slot. D2H can send the prior output while compute uses the other slot. Hidden and residual each have a ready event.
rank.sendNote.zh-CN: Stage 在 Source Slot 中发布输出。若捕获的计算图返回独立存储，先将输出复制到该 Slot。D2H 搬运上一份输出时，下一项计算使用另一个 Slot；Hidden 和 Residual 各有就绪事件。

rank.reuseNote.en: D2H completion releases the source slot. The consumer event releases the receive slot. The host progress thread advances DMA and reuses each host segment after H2D completes.
rank.reuseNote.zh-CN: Host 侧按完成事件归还物理 Slot。Source 跟随 D2H 完成释放，Receive 跟随 Consumer Event 释放；Progress Thread 持续推进 DMA，并在 H2D 完成后复用 Host Segment。

dma.diagram.en: Segmented DMA events between GPU0 and GPU1
dma.diagram.zh-CN: 上游GPU0和下游GPU1分段DMA的事件时间线

dma.cycle.zh-CN: 逐段 H2D 后循环复用

dma.readyNote.en: GPU0 records separate ready events for the residual and hidden planes. As each plane becomes ready, the progress thread can prepare its segments.
dma.readyNote.zh-CN: GPU0 的计算先后记录 Residual / Hidden 的 Plane-ready Event。Progress Thread 看到已就绪的 Plane，就能准备它对应的 Segment。

dma.d2hNote.en: The host queues one segment's D2H copy and its completion event on the send stream, then publishes READY with the event generation the receiver should wait for.
dma.d2hNote.zh-CN: GPU0 的 CPU 把一个 Segment 的 D2H 和完成 Event 排入发送流，然后发布 READY。READY 把这一代事件的身份交给接收端。

dma.h2dNote.en: GPU1 queues Wait(D2H event) → H2D → H2D event, then publishes ACK. The copy engine starts H2D as soon as the D2H dependency is satisfied.
dma.h2dNote.zh-CN: GPU1 提前排好 Wait(D2H Event) → H2D → H2D Event，随后发布 ACK。Copy Engine 在 D2H 的事件满足后自动开始 H2D，命令提交与实际搬运由这条依赖衔接。

dma.pipelineNote.en: D2H for one segment overlaps H2D for the previous segment. Eight host segments carry the full 160 MiB boundary in turns. Reusing a ring position requires its ACK and H2D completion.
dma.pipelineNote.zh-CN: 一段 D2H 与前一段 H2D 交错推进。8 个 Host Segment 循环承接整份 160 MiB 数据；复用某个 Ring 位置前，发送端确认对应 ACK 和 H2D 完成事件。

dma.receivedNote.en: GPU1 has the full input. Its compute stream passes the receive event and starts S1(C0). GPU0 has released its source slot after D2H, and this chunk has passed through the host ring.
dma.receivedNote.zh-CN: 完整输入到达 GPU1，Compute Stream 越过接收 Event 开始 S1(C0)。GPU0 的 Source 已随 D2H 完成归还，Host Ring 也已完成这一份数据的传递。

dma.releaseNote.en: When S1(C0) finishes reading the input, its consumer event releases the receive slot. Source slots, host segments and receive slots become reusable at different points, each after its last reader finishes.
dma.releaseNote.zh-CN: GPU1 完成 S1(C0) 的输入消费后，Consumer Event 归还 Receive Slot。Source、Host Segment、Receive 各按自己的最后一次读取时间释放。

load.diagram.en: KV work across 170 CTAs under native splitting and global bucketing
load.diagram.zh-CN: 原生Split和Bucket在170个CTA上的KV工作量

load.uniformStart.en: With uniform context lengths the native split already balances work. The heaviest CTA in either schedule handles <strong>
load.uniformStart.zh-CN: 均匀上下文下，原生分配已经接近等重；两种方法的最重 CTA 都是 <strong>

load.uniformEnd.zh-CN: 个 Tile。任务组织的选择可以跟随这份几何信息。

load.skewNote.en: Native splitting concentrates the long request on a few CTAs. The busiest handles {0} tiles. Global buckets assign about {1} tiles each and start a new task wherever a bucket crosses a request boundary.
load.skewNote.zh-CN: 长请求在原生划分中集中于少量 Split，最重 CTA 处理 {0} 个 Tile。全局 Bucket 用每份 {1} 个 Tile 的预算重新组织工作，跨请求边界建立新的 Task。

bucket.tileSize.zh-CN: 每个小块 = 256 个 KV Token

bucket.summary.en: {0} tiles total · {1} CTAs available · {2} tiles per bucket
bucket.summary.zh-CN: 总工作量 {0} Tiles · CTA 预算 {1} · 每 Bucket {2} Tiles

bucket.skew.en: B32: one long request and 31 short ones
bucket.skew.zh-CN: B32：一个长请求，31 个短请求

bucket.tileAxis.en: Lay out the KV tiles along one global axis
bucket.tileAxis.zh-CN: 把 KV 工作展开为全局 Tile 轴

bucket.boundary.en: Start a new task at each request boundary
bucket.boundary.zh-CN: 跨请求边界时建立新的 Task

bucket.select.en: 170 buckets · Select a CTA to inspect its tasks
bucket.select.zh-CN: 170 个 Bucket · 点击一个 CTA 查看其 Task

bucket.ctaPath.en: Each CTA executes its tasks in order within one launch
bucket.ctaPath.zh-CN: 一个 CTA 在一次 Launch 内顺序执行自己的 Task

bucket.readTiles.zh-CN: 遍历自己的 KV Tile 区间

bucket.write.zh-CN: 写出该 Task 的 Partial

bucket.max.en: 170 CTAs · at most 6 tiles per CTA

bucket.mergeTitle.en: Write one partial per task and merge by request
bucket.mergeTitle.zh-CN: Partial 以 Task 为单位，按 Request 合并

bucket.other.en: Other requests follow the same partial-to-merge path to their own outputs.
bucket.other.zh-CN: 其余请求沿相同的 Partial → Merge 路径得到各自输出。

bucket.diagram.en: Step through KV tiles, tasks and buckets
bucket.diagram.zh-CN: KV Tile到Task与Bucket的手动分步图

bucket.requestsNote.en: Read the KV lengths for this batch. Each request keeps its own Q, KV page table and output position.
bucket.requestsNote.zh-CN: 先读取当前 Batch 的 KV 长度。每个请求保持自己的 Q、KV Page Table 和最终输出位置。

bucket.tilesNote.en: Count tiles in units of 256 tokens, then compute their global prefix offsets. Each tile retains its request ID. KV data stays in the paged cache.
bucket.tilesNote.zh-CN: 按 256 Token 统计 Tile 数，再计算全局前缀位置。每个 Tile 都携带 Request 身份，KV 数据继续保留在原有分页 Cache 中。

bucket.packNote.en: Each bucket has a budget of {0} tiles. CTA {1} has {2} task(s){3}
bucket.packNote.zh-CN: 每个 Bucket 预算为 {0} 个 Tile。当前 CTA {1} 包含 {2} 个 Task{3}

bucket.cross.en: because its range crosses a request boundary.
bucket.cross.zh-CN: ，因为这一份预算跨过了 Request 边界。

bucket.same.zh-CN: ，这一份工作落在同一个请求内。

bucket.runNote.en: A CTA walks its bucket in task order. All tiles in a task share an online softmax accumulator. Finishing the task publishes one partial result.
bucket.runNote.zh-CN: 一个 CTA 读取自己的 Bucket，依次执行其中的 Task。Task 内的多个 Tile 共享一次 Online Softmax 累加过程，Task 结束才发布一份 Partial。

bucket.mergeNote.en: A counter collects partials for each request. The CTA that finishes the last task reads all its partials and writes the final O. A single-task request writes O directly.
bucket.mergeNote.zh-CN: 同一请求的 Partial 通过请求级计数器汇合。最后完成的 Task 所在 CTA 读入该请求的所有 Partial，得到最终 O；单 Task 请求直接写最终结果。

merge.reweight.en: Read 5 partials → reweight by softmax mass
merge.reweight.zh-CN: 读取 5 份 Partial → Softmax 重加权

merge.order.en: Finish order: T2 → T0 → T4 → T3 → T1
merge.order.zh-CN: 完成顺序：T2 → T0 → T4 → T3 → T1

merge.reset.zh-CN: 写出结果，本轮计数复位

merge.publish.en: Each finisher publishes its own partial
merge.publish.zh-CN: 每个完成者只发布自己的 Partial

merge.diagram.en: Five tasks publish partials in completion order and the last CTA merges them
merge.diagram.zh-CN: 五个Task按完成顺序发布Partial并由最后完成者归约

merge.startNote.en: R0 has five tasks on different CTAs. Each has its own scratch slot.
merge.startNote.zh-CN: R0 被拆成五份 Task。它们在不同 CTA 上推进，Scratch 为每份 Task 保留独立位置。

merge.t2Note.en: T2 finishes first, stores O₂, m₂ and l₂, then increments the completion count for R0.
merge.t2Note.zh-CN: T2 先完成，写出自己的 O₂、m₂、l₂，并更新 R0 的完成计数。

merge.t0Note.en: T0 finishes. Two partials are ready in scratch while the other tasks keep running.
merge.t0Note.zh-CN: T0 完成后，Scratch 中已有两份 Partial。其余 Task 继续推进。

merge.t4Note.en: T4 has finished. T3 and T1 are still running. Completion order determines which CTA will merge the results.
merge.t4Note.zh-CN: T4 已经完成，接下来仍等待 T3 和 T1；归约职责由实际完成顺序决定。

merge.t3Note.en: Four partials are ready. The CTA running T1 is finishing the last task.
merge.t3Note.zh-CN: 四份 Partial 已就绪。T1 所在 CTA 正在完成最后一份工作。

merge.t1Note.en: T1 increments the counter and sees the previous value 4. As the last finisher it reads all five partials, reweights them by softmax mass and writes O_R0.
merge.t1Note.zh-CN: T1 的计数更新读到上一值 4，取得最后完成者身份。它读取五份 Partial，按 Softmax 质量重加权，直接写出 O_R0。

norm.inputNote.en: Read x, the residual and the norm weights. One CTA adds the residual and reduces the sum of squares across a row of 5,120 elements.
norm.inputNote.zh-CN: 读取 x、Residual 与归一化权重。一行 5120 个元素在 CTA 内完成 Residual 相加和平方和归约。

norm.fusedNote.en: Each warp reduces its sum of squares by shuffle. Ten FP32 partials meet in shared memory; warp 0 computes the inverse RMS. Each thread rounds 16 normalized values to BF16 and packs them with one E4M3 scale.
norm.fusedNote.zh-CN: 每个 warp 用 shuffle 归约平方和，10 个 FP32 部分和汇入共享内存，由 warp 0 算出 RMS 的倒数。随后每个线程将 16 个归一化结果舍入到 BF16，再量化打包，共用一个 E4M3 scale。

norm.nativeNote.en: Add and RMSNorm produce BF16 y. A separate quantizer reads that tensor and packs it into NVFP4.
norm.nativeNote.zh-CN: Add / RMSNorm 产生 BF16 y，随后量化操作从这个中间 Tensor 读入数值并打包 NVFP4。

norm.outNote.en: The kernel writes the BF16 residual, packed FP4 values and native-layout scales. The MLP GEMM reads the packed input directly.
norm.outNote.zh-CN: 一次写回同时交付 BF16 Residual、Packed FP4 和原生布局的 Scale。MLP GEMM 直接消费量化输入。

norm.unfusedOut.en: The BF16 residual is retained. A separate quantization stage supplies packed FP4 and scales to the MLP GEMM.
norm.unfusedOut.zh-CN: BF16 Residual 保留；独立的量化阶段交付 Packed FP4 与 Scale，供 MLP GEMM 读取。

front.inputNote.en: Read the QKV projection outputs, positions, slot mapping and quantization scales. The Q side also supplies the gate used after attention.
front.inputNote.zh-CN: 读取 QKV Projection 的输出，以及位置、Slot Mapping 和量化 Scale。Q 侧同时携带后续门控需要的 Gate。

front.fusedNote.en: One 128-thread CTA handles a token and a Q or K head. Four warps combine their sums through shared memory. On the K path, rotated values feed the FP4 packer directly. V is read from the projection and packed for the same cache slot.
front.fusedNote.zh-CN: 每个 128 线程的 CTA 负责一个 token 的一个 Q 或 K head，4 个 warp 通过共享内存合并平方和。K 旋转后的值直接进入 FP4 打包逻辑。V 从投影输出中读出，量化后写入同一缓存 slot。

front.nativeNote.en: Q and K first undergo their per-head transforms. A subsequent quantize-and-append stage reads K and V and writes their pages.
front.nativeNote.zh-CN: Q / K 的变换先生成对应数据；KV 量化与分页 Append 在下一处理边界消费 K、V。

front.outNote.en: Attention receives BF16 Q and the gate, plus NVFP4 K/V and scales in the paged cache. It reads the existing page table and native data layout.
front.outNote.zh-CN: 最终交付 BF16 Q + Gate，以及分页 Cache 中的 NVFP4 K/V + Scale。Attention 读取既有 Page Table 与原生数据布局。

tail.inputNote.en: A single task produces O directly. With multiple tasks the last CTA merges their partials. At this point the softmax reduction covers the request's full KV range.
tail.inputNote.zh-CN: 单 Task 直接得到 O，多 Task 在 Last-CTA Merge 后得到 O；这一阶段已经完成整个请求 KV 范围的 Softmax 归约。

tail.fusedNote.en: The final writer applies BF16 sigmoid(gate), a BF16 multiply and static FP8 quantization in sequence to produce the projection input.
tail.fusedNote.zh-CN: 最终写出者依次执行 BF16 sigmoid(gate)、BF16 乘法和静态 FP8 量化，直接生成投影的输入格式。

tail.nativeNote.en: Attention stores BF16 O. The native compiled epilogue reads it, applies the gate and quantizes to FP8.
tail.nativeNote.zh-CN: Attention 写出 BF16 O，原生编译尾处理读取它，完成 Gate 乘法与 FP8 量化。

tail.outNote.en: The final store writes E4M3 FP8 directly for the output projection. Partial computation and merging keep their existing formats.
tail.outNote.zh-CN: 输出直接以 E4M3 FP8 写回，接入 Output Projection。Partial 的计算与合并继续沿用原来的数据格式。

tail.unfusedOut.en: The epilogue writes the FP8 tensor consumed by the output projection.
tail.unfusedOut.zh-CN: FP8 Tensor 由尾处理阶段写出，再进入 Output Projection。
